english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for “now” at the present time.

exampleSentences.english: I need to go to work now.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 faan1 gung1

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong Cantonese equivalent for saying something is true now or at present.

exampleSentences.english: I am currently doing homework at home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我而家喺屋企做緊功課。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei2 zou6 gan2 gung1 fo3

english.note: Use this for “actually” meaning “currently” or “at the moment,” not for emphasis or correction.

exampleSentences.english: I'm actually in a meeting at the office right now.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ngo5 hai2 gung1 si1 hoi1 gan2 wui2

english.note: Use 而家 when English “here” means that something is now present or happening.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 jau5 wai2 haak3 hai2 dou6
